title: Backward-facing step
description: 2D backward-facing step, expansion ratio 1.125 (Driver and Seegmiller geometry): step height h, inlet channel height 8h. Turbulent validation case for reattachment length; laminar variants for code verification.

mesh.note: lengths in units of step height h

reference.citation: D. M. Driver, H. L. Seegmiller, Features of a reattaching turbulent shear layer in divergent channel flow, AIAA J. 23 (1985) 163-171; J. K. Eaton, J. P. Johnston, A review of research on subsonic turbulent flow reattachment, AIAA J. 19 (1981) 1093-1100.
reference.tolerance: literature scatter, roughly 5.5 to 7 step heights for RANS models
